notes: Version 0.10.7. When you cast a targeted attack skill with auto attack on, the bot used to throw a stray melee swing in the middle of the cast. It now holds the swing until the cast lands and then carries on, so a ranged cast no longer turns into a stray melee. New optional Setup toggle for Necromancers, Cast DeathNova if a spell leaves you frozen: if a spell ever leaves you stuck moving very slowly for more than two seconds, the bot casts DeathNova once at your own feet to reset your speed. It is off by default and only runs on a Necromancer. Characters that can cast while moving now move the way the game intends during a cast. Support logs now hide your login details, so a log you send in for help never carries your password. Update from the app as usual, it reinstalls everything for you.
